next.reason: 1985 GR15: on the invalid key condition the WRITE is unsuccessful, 'the content of the record area is unaffected', the I-O status is set to a value indicating the cause, and execution proceeds per the invalid key rules. §2023:14.9.51.4 GR15: an unsuccessful WRITE means 'the write operation does not take place, the content of the record area is unaffected', the I-O status is set to the cause, and control follows 9.1.14; §2023:9.1.14 GR1 sets the status 'to a value indicating the invalid key condition'. GR33 and GR29 define which WRITEs raise the condition, the matter of 1985 GR14. EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY is set only 'if enabled'. Same.
